timeline.text: Night charge nurse called IT on-call: ransom note on 6 workstations at College Station clinic
Incident declared by Sam Okafor: Ransomware encrypted EHR file servers
Disconnected College Station and Bryan clinic switches from WAN
Jordan Patel assumed Incident Commander. All response comms moved to WINDX; corporate email treated as compromised
Disabled all VPN accounts except break-glass; forced global password reset queued
Engaged Hale & Ridley LLP as breach counsel; Northgate DFIR retained through counsel to preserve privilege
Notified Lone Star Mutual Cyber (claim #LSM-88412). Carrier approved Northgate as panel vendor
Ransom note identifies BlackSuit. Encrypted extension .blacksuit. Leak-site post claims 400 GB including "patients" folder
EDR shows initial VPN login from 185.220.101.4 using account c.martin (contractor, offboarded in June, never disabled)
Backups on BKUP-01 partially encrypted; offline tape set from Oct 31 confirmed intact
Rclone transfer logs found on FS02: ~380 GB uploaded to mega[.]nz between Nov 3 and Nov 5
Blocked C2 domains and IPs at the firewall (see Indicators)
Counsel determination: reportable breach of PHI. HIPAA and Texas notification clocks confirmed
CEO: no contact with threat actor; ransom payment not authorized pending OFAC review and counsel advice
Northgate began imaging DC02 and FS02 memory

incidents.title: Ransomware encrypted EHR file servers; ransom note on clinic workstations
incidents.summary: At 02:10 local, night staff at the College Station clinic reported workstations showing a ransom note ("BlackSuit"). File servers FS01/FS02 hosting scanned patient records and billing exports are encrypted. The threat actor claims 400 GB was exfiltrated and has posted a sample on their leak site. Clinics are on paper downtime procedures. EHR (cloud-hosted) is unaffected so far.

messages.text: Quarterly WINDX drill complete. Everyone confirmed MFA works. Thanks all.

BLACK HERON (SEV1) has been declared. Responders join #black-heron.
Isolating College Station + Bryan now. Do NOT power anything off. Leave machines on for memory capture.
I have command. Assume email and Teams are compromised. Everything goes through WINDX or phone from here.
Hale & Ridley engaged. Northgate will be retained through counsel. Please mark analysis "prepared at direction of counsel".
Confirmed exfil: rclone to mega.nz, ~380GB, Nov 3-5. Adding to Scope now.
Breach determination recorded. Texas AG notice is due within 30 days (>250 Texans). WINDX has the clock running.
Morgan: per OFAC guidance we cannot evaluate any payment until attribution is confirmed against the SDN list. Recommend no contact with the actor.
IR-2026-0002 "SILVER SPARROW" declared at SEV2. This is the incident room.
Understood. No contact, no payment. Please prep a board briefing for tomorrow 9am.
Recall filed with Frost. They say first 72h matter most. Dana, can you loop in Hale & Ridley?
All hands: 15:00 UTC bridge call is cancelled. Updates in this room only. Acknowledge please.
